findings.description: The missing-CA-bundle check now calls warnings.warn instead of raising OSError, so an invalid or missing cert_loc no longer stops the request.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the CA bundle path does not exist, for example when certifi is loaded from a zip and the extraction call is gone, or REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE points to a missing file. Mechanism: the code now warns and continues with the nonexistent cert_loc instead of raising. Impact: the request proceeds with a bad CA path and fails later with an obscure SSL error, or the error is only visible as a warning. The commit title only announces removing the extraction call, not changing the error to a warning.
